review:
Misery Mining is a 7x7 mining slot where only the central 3x3 area starts open. xBombs exploding next to a barrier push it back one step, gradually opening the grid and raising the multiplier.

Three scatters or one or two super scatters trigger Misery FreeSpins, starting with a 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 area, and xSize can enlarge symbols. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 70,000x cap. A big, slow build.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
